test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: This card works
test.hint: Click pass here, fold the card with its header, unfold it. The results file updates.

test.title: Rig rows on the build card
test.hint: Junction tool, build mode, under 'swept path': small rig and big rig say 'must fit', semi says 'not checked'.

test.title: Clicking a rig row toggles it
test.hint: Click 'semi': it changes to 'must fit' (ticks itself). Click again to set it back.

test.title: Locked site shows fit counts
test.passLog: fits %d+ of the %d+ turns this build lays
test.hint: Lock a junction in build mode (try 52 or 7). Each rig row adds 'n/m fit' (ticks itself).

test.title: Skew build: tight turn on asphalt
test.hint: Clear 52 or 7 (through roads kept), then build. The sharp turn runs along the asphalt edge, only the trailer crosses the gravel shoulder, nothing refused.

test.title: A save keeps the split
test.hint: Change a split decision, save the game, reload: the decision is still there.

test.title: Clear works as before
test.hint: Clear a junction you know: same result as the last build.
